overview.about: LIV Golf South Africa is held at The Club at Steyn City on the northern edge of Johannesburg, a lavish modern development set high on the Highveld. It brings LIV's team golf to one of the sport's strong and long-established markets.
overview.nextEvent: The next LIV Golf South Africa is played over 54 holes at Steyn City, individual and team titles together. The high-altitude Highveld setting, like Mexico City, adds distance and a distinct feel to the golf.
